summary: Ownership, roles, commerce writes, inventory reservations, rider assignment, and image uploads are enforced and emulator tested. App Check and a review of existing production roles remain.

findings.issue: Direct client order and inventory writes could permit forged totals or stock changes.
findings.impact: Orders and inventory could lose integrity.
findings.attackScenario: A modified client submits a fake price or skips stock deduction.
findings.fix: Deny client order writes and use transactional placeOrder with server pricing and saved-address ownership checks.

findings.issue: Role changes and rider approval require server authorization.
findings.attackScenario: A customer changes their role or approves their own application.
findings.fix: Allow-list customer profile fields and approve riders only through an admin-checked callable.

findings.issue: Stock, reservations, and rider assignment were vulnerable to concurrent requests.
findings.impact: A bouquet could be oversold or a delivery assigned twice.
findings.attackScenario: Two devices purchase or accept the same last available item simultaneously.
findings.fix: Use transactions and idempotency records; concurrency tests confirm one winner.

findings.issue: Product image uploads required role, path, size, and MIME restrictions.
findings.impact: Unauthorized or oversized files could be stored.
findings.attackScenario: A customer uploads non-image content to a product folder.
findings.fix: Restrict writes to florist/admin and to 5 MB JPEG, PNG, or WebP images.

findings.issue: Firebase App Check is not enforced yet.
findings.impact: Authenticated scripts can call the validated backend outside the official app.
findings.attackScenario: Automation sends repeated valid requests using a real account.
findings.fix: Configure App Check in Flutter, verify metrics, then enable enforceAppCheck.

findings.issue: Existing privileged role documents were not enumerated locally.
findings.impact: A stale privileged account would keep its access.
findings.attackScenario: A test account already has an admin, florist, or rider role.
findings.fix: Review all non-customer roles in Firebase before broad release.

findings.issue: Tokenized product image URLs are shareable.
findings.impact: Product photos may be viewed outside an authenticated session.
findings.attackScenario: A user shares an image URL.
findings.fix: Keep private media out of product folders and revoke tokens if needed.

findings.issue: npm reports seven moderate findings through the Firebase dependency tree and uuid.
findings.impact: The reported uuid buffer issue exists in transitive packages, although this backend does not call the affected buffer API directly.
findings.attackScenario: An affected dependency path processes an attacker-controlled UUID buffer.
findings.fix: Track updated Firebase packages. Do not apply the suggested forced downgrade to firebase-admin 10.3.0; rerun npm audit before release.

verifiedControls: Customer order and address ownership is enforced
Customers cannot change roles, products, reservations, or orders
Storage uploads validate role, folder, MIME type, and size

validation.npmAudit: 7 moderate transitive findings; the forced fix would install a breaking Firebase Admin version
